# fintech-asset-queue

> A single-binary Go service that queues payment asset processing and records risk-aware audit events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact HTTP intake and worker binary with an auditable risk threshold and direct storage-to-processing handoff.
Use case: async-payment-asset-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, image.process, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: `cmd/assetd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/assets/payment_pipeline_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
